id.description: Stable id used to address this spec from elsewhere, e.g. a docs claim pointing at `shop.c4#bff`. Defaults to the file basename without extension.

url.description: Web URL of the repo, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo. Only http(s) URLs are accepted.

revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA used in source links. Default HEAD.

proposed.description: This spec describes something that does not exist. It renders with a visible marker everywhere it appears, its claims are never reported as verified against code, and the drift check ignores it — there is nothing for it to drift from. Use it for a design under discussion, never for something that merely has not been built yet but was agreed.

proposal.description: Where the proposal came from, so a reader can find the discussion rather than guess.

issue.description: URL of the issue or discussion this came out of.

summary.description: One sentence on what is being proposed and why, shown in the banner.

sources.description: Where this thing lives in code. Rendered as links when meta.repository.url is set.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path: no leading slash, drive letter, URL scheme, or ".." segment

cards.description: Optional notes shown under the diagram. Max 4 recommended.
